forecast_note: Model trained on open data, applied to simulated patients with an offset calibrated on each patient's first 3 days (D-070). Simulated patients, not clinical evidence. The 80 % range is the calibrated forecast plus the 10th to 90th percentile of the calibration-day errors pooled over all simulated patients. Compared with assuming glucose stays where it is (persistence), the calibrated forecast is better at +30 min, better at +60 min, better at +120 min.

forecast_eval.title: Forecast error on the console's simulated patients (simulated)
forecast_eval.sub: Mean absolute error, mg/dL, 95 % patient-bootstrap interval. 120 simulated patients, every 15 minutes from day 4 on (126,240 anchors at +60 min). Calibration: an offset from each patient's first 3 days (D-062, D-070).
forecast_eval.note: Share of readings inside the 80 % range, mean over patients: calibrated +30 min 80 %, +60 min 81 %, +120 min 81 %; without calibration +30 min 83 %, +60 min 82 %, +120 min 82 %. Calibrated minus persistence at +60 min: -1.8 mg/dL [-2.9, -0.8]. Compared with assuming glucose stays where it is (persistence), the calibrated forecast is better at +30 min, better at +60 min, better at +120 min. Simulated patients, not clinical evidence.
